title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - InterconnectionServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/InterconnectionServiceOffering. Definition marked 'TBD' (to be determined) in the source ontology. Subclass of NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InterconnectionServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

connectedNetworkA.description: Property. Autonomous system (AS) number (ASN) of the side A.

connectedNetworkZ.description: Property. Autonomous system (AS) number (ASN) of the side Z.

prefixSetA.description: Property. CIDR Provider Identifier of the network on the side A.

prefixSetZ.description: Property. CIDR Provider Identifier of the network on the side Z.

vlanConfiguration.description: Relationship. VLAN configuration. Links to a VLANConfiguration entity.

connectionType.description: Property. The supported types of connection, preferably specified as controlled vocabulary.

interfaceType.description: Property. A type of physical interface, e.g. Copper cable, 5G.
